How To Install Plex Media Server on Raspberry Pi

Did it on a fairly new Pi3, and it does work OK. It does struggle with some video codecs though, not quite figured out which ones yet, or if there is some way around it. Just be aware there might be performance issues.

IMO, the Pi is better suited to acting as a Plex client rather than a server. I have a 3B in the other room running RasPlex and it works great.

Meanwhile, the server itself is running on my desktop, where it can stream direct or transcode to any client in the house as needed.

Here's a thread near and dear to my heart.

Just would like to add that you can also run Plex from a docker container without having to install anything additional software. (although you wouldn't want to do this on a pi)

i.e.

Example 1 : A container which will self destruct when stopped with 3 mapped folders /mnt/media/{Music TV_Shows Movies}. These will all be accessible inside the container as **/media{Music TV_Shows Moves} **

docker run --rm -d --name adolphs_hitlist --network=host \
-v /mnt/media/video/Movies:/meida/Movies \
-v /mnt/media/music:/media/Music \
-v /mnt/media/video/TV_Shows:/media/TV_Shows \
plexinc/pms-docker

Example 2 : Same as above but auto starts with docker service making it always available.

docker run --restart=always -d --name adolphs_hitlist --network=host \
-v /mnt/media/video/Movies:/meida/Movies \
-v /mnt/media/music:/media/Music \
-v /mnt/media/video/TV_Shows:/media/TV_Shows \
plexinc/pms-docker

Resources:

  • https://docs.docker.com/engine/reference/commandline/cli/
  • https://hub.docker.com/r/plexinc/pms-docker
  • https://hub.docker.com/r/wernight/plex-media-server (another version I've used with good results)
